options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name of the textbox (aria-labelledby).

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial value in `valueFormat` (sanitized when HTML); also the value restored by reset(). Passing it to update() replaces the content.

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Format of `value`, getFormValue(), and event details. Default 'html' in rich mode and 'text' in plain mode.

options.name: mode
options.description: 'plain': no formatting and no toolbar; paragraphs and line breaks only. Switching to 'plain' converts the content to plain text.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name; a hidden input carries the value for native form submission.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown while the editor is empty (also aria-placeholder); never replaces the label.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: Empty (or whitespace-only) text is invalid; shows the required indicator and sets aria-required.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Not editable and not focusable; toolbar tools are aria-disabled.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Focusable and submitted but not editable (aria-readonly).

options.name: minLength
options.description: Minimum length of the plain text in code points (integer >= 0, <= maxLength).

options.name: maxLength
options.description: Maximum length of the plain text in code points (validated, not truncated).

options.name: showCounter
options.description: Show remaining/over characters; requires maxLength.

options.name: toolbar
options.description: Toolbar items in order; '|' is a separator. Heading items for levels not in `headings` are omitted. Hotkeys and Markdown shortcuts work regardless of the items shown.

options.name: headings
options.description: Heading levels offered and accepted from HTML/Markdown (non-empty); other levels map to the nearest allowed lower level.

options.name: linkSchemes
options.description: URL schemes allowed in links besides relative URLs (lowercase, without ':'). javascript, data, and vbscript are never allowed and throw.

options.name: rows
options.description: Minimum visible height in text rows, integer 1..100.

options.name: maxRows
options.description: Maximum height in rows (integer >= rows, <= 100); the content scrolls beyond it.

options.name: spellcheck
options.description: Native spellcheck on the content element.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation of the value in `valueFormat`; return a message to mark it invalid. Runs after the built-in constraints pass.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: markdownShortcuts
options.description: Markdown typing shortcuts: '# ', '- ', '1. ', '> ', '```' + Enter, **bold**, *italic*, `code`, ~~strike~~ (rich mode only).

options.name: historyLimit
options.description: Undo depth, integer 0..1000. Typing (or deleting) within 1 s is one undo step.

options.name: locale
options.description: Toolbar, link panel, announcement, and validation message locale; word and grapheme boundaries for deletion.

options.name: direction
options.description: 'rtl' sets dir="rtl" on the content element ('ltr' leaves dir="auto") and maps formatJustifyLeft/Right to end/start.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: content
properties.description: The contenteditable element (role="textbox", aria-multiline="true"). Do not mutate its DOM.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value in `valueFormat` ('' when empty in html/markdown).

properties.name: formatState
properties.description: Formatting at the selection: { marks, block, align, link, canUndo, canRedo }, for custom toolbars.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Content differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: getHTML
methods.description: Content as sanitized HTML ('' when empty; plain text in plain mode).

methods.name: setHTML
methods.description: Replace the content from HTML (sanitized); no events; clears history and an external custom error.

methods.name: getMarkdown
methods.description: Content as Markdown ('' when empty; plain text in plain mode).

methods.name: setMarkdown
methods.description: Replace the content from Markdown; no events; clears history and an external custom error.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Plain text; blocks are separated by a line break.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Replace the content from plain text (one paragraph per line); no events; clears history.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Replace the content from a value in `valueFormat`; no events; clears history and an external custom error.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Run a toolbar command at the selection (for custom toolbars). No-op when disabled or read-only; formatting commands are no-ops in plain mode.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo one step; returns false when there is nothing to undo. Emits aui-input.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redo one step; returns false when there is nothing to redo. Emits aui-input.

methods.name: insertText
methods.description: Insert text at the selection (replacing it) with the current style, as an edit (emits aui-input).

methods.name: openLinkEditor
methods.description: Open the link panel for the selection or the link around the caret (Mod+K); focuses the address field.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options (validated first). `value` replaces the content.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits. null or '' clears it.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the content and restore the last selection.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value; clear history and dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, form registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-input
events.description: The user edited the content (typing, deletion, formatting, paste, drop, cut, undo, redo).

events.name: aui-change
events.description: Focus left the component (host) and the content differs from when it was focused.

cssClasses.name: aui-rte__tool | aui-rte__tool--text | aui-rte__tool--active
cssClasses.description: Toolbar button (data-command=item); --text: text label (P, H1-H3); --active: link tool while the caret is in a link.

cssClasses.name: aui-rte__surface
cssClasses.description: Bordered, scrolling container of the content; the control boundary and focus indicator.

cssClasses.name: aui-rte__block | aui-rte__code | aui-rte__list | aui-rte__link
cssClasses.description: Rendered blocks, code block, list containers, and links inside the content.

cssClasses.name: aui-rte__align-center | aui-rte__align-end | aui-rte__align-justify
cssClasses.description: Alignment classes on rendered blocks inside the editor (the HTML output uses data-align instead).
